disagreements.a: stylized world map and satellite network graphic
disagreements.resolution: Image shows a world-map silhouette (continents visible) overlaid with a network of connected dots/lines, not a 3D globe — used 'world map ... network of connected nodes/lines' per A's map description combined with B's network phrasing.

disagreements.a: laptop/smartphone displaying a monitoring dashboard with map view
disagreements.resolution: Both consistent with image (software window with embedded map, same map mirrored on phone); merged wording, no real conflict.

disagreements.a: worker in gloves lifting a manhole cover to access a monitoring device
disagreements.b: gloved worker installing a sensor unit under a manhole cover
disagreements.resolution: Image shows gloved hands reaching into an already-open vault with the cover/board propped to the side, and a device (valve-like unit) inside — resolved as 'reaching into an open manhole/vault ... accessing a monitoring device,' since 'installing' vs 'lifting' cannot be confirmed from the still image and 'accessing' is the safer, image-supported description.

disagreements.a: sensor mounted on a weir/channel structure over water
disagreements.b: sensor mounted on a bracket over open water
disagreements.resolution: Image shows a white sensor on a bracket/arm extending from a concrete edge over water; combined both descriptions ('bracket/arm ... over open water at the edge of a structure').

disagreements.a: SmartCover logo mark described in separate bracket at top left
disagreements.b: SmartCover logo mentioned inline within the main scene description
disagreements.resolution: Same fact (dotted circular swirl logo, top left), only placement in the write-up differs — merged into one description, no image conflict.
